name: הָם
summary: Ham is the place where Chedorlaomer and his allies struck the Zuzim. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The phrase וְאֶת הַזּוּזִים בְּהָם pairs the Zuzim with Ham, just as the surrounding phrases pair the Rephaim and the Emim with the places of their defeat.

note: Moved from the former word entry `haam` (old root key המ). Not the name חָם of Noah’s son (names/7aam).
